'''Gatral''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] aligned with [[Crutag]] while he tracked a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents on [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]] and [[Trinta]]. Encountering ex-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Halagad Ventor]], the Jedi used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to drive the bounty hunters insane. Ventor would then "resurrect" them as illusions to chase the Alliance members they were hunting.
